subject.title: fix: recover precheck context overflows with measured counts

question: Should this protected-label PR be closed as superseded by the merged replacement at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101181, or kept for a maintainer-specific adoption reason?
rationale: Automation must not close a `maintainer`-labeled PR, but source and GitHub evidence show the useful measured-count behavior is already on current `main`.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR manually and point to the merged replacement commit because current `main` already carries the central fix.

options.title: Keep for adoption
options.body: Keep this PR open only if a maintainer identifies a unique branch-specific change not covered by the merged replacement.

options.title: Remove protected label
options.body: Remove the protected label only if maintainers want deterministic cleanup automation to handle the superseded branch later.
